A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GFS-VL paper, with 16 pages including five pages of supplementary material. Full-text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables, figures and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original segmentation experiments on ScanNet200, ScanNet++ and ScanNet, component ablations in Table 5, and qualitative results in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark, ablation and qualitative results in Section 5 and the supplementary material.

M1.justification: The GFS-VL architecture and procedures are unchanged, including prototype-guided pseudo-label selection, adaptive infilling and Novel-Base Mix. Section 4 and supplementary Algorithm 1 retain the same method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ScanNet200, ScanNet++ and ScanNet tasks. Benchmark class lists, represented domains and support scenarios are unchanged, including supplementary Section 8.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain their respective PIFS, attMPTI, COSeg, GW, CAPL and fully supervised comparisons. Table 5 retains the same VLM and mixing comparators. COSeg's change from citation [2] to [1] does not change comparator identity.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1–5.3 and supplementary Section 9 retain the same splits, 0.02 m voxelization, whole-scene testing, 1-shot and 5-shot settings, training budgets, backbones and evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: Table 5 retains all component, threshold, mixing-block, backbone, VLM and mixing-strategy analyses. The qualitative comparisons and pseudo-label refinement examples in Figures 3–8 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging main results across five randomly seeded support sets and using one support set for ablations. Neither introduces confidence intervals, significance tests or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All reported empirical values and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 reports the same GFS-VL 5-shot ScanNet200 mIoU-N of 31.67 and HM of 43.12 in both versions.

T1.justification: The formal task definition in Section 3.1 and equations (1)–(11) remain identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: combining 3D VLM knowledge with few-shot supervision, introducing three method components and two benchmarks, and claiming strong performance across datasets and models.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning pseudo-label reliability, contextual preservation and generalization are unchanged. Supplementary Section 10 retains the same limitations involving small objects, thin objects and complex backgrounds.

D1.justification: The implementation disclosures remain identical, including Algorithm 1, class lists, prompts, optimizers, learning rates, training epochs, four RTX 4090 GPUs and preprocessing instructions. The supplied code link is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are unchanged. References [1] and [2] exchange numbers, and one ICLR publication year is updated; these are bibliographic edits rather than additions or changes in positioning.

P1.justification: v2 swaps the first two bibliography entries and corresponding citation numbers, changes the ICLR year for 'Multimodality helps few-shot 3D point cloud semantic segmentation' from 2024 to 2025, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Prose and section structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–5 and Algorithm 1 retain their content, structure, captions and placement. Citation-number substitutions in Tables 2–3 do not change their layout; the supplementary pages render identically.

improvement.justification: The changes are limited to bibliographic metadata, citation ordering and version labeling. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, limitations and complete supplement remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
